_note: Engine-wide settings. Every threshold used by a rule lives here so that it can be reviewed and changed without touching code.

scoring.description: score = Σ(weight × credit) / Σ(weight of applicable checks) × 100. NOT_APPLICABLE checks are excluded from the denominator. The score is informational; the overall status is decided by the status rules below.

overall_status_rules: Any NON_COMPLIANT check with HIGH severity  -> NON_COMPLIANT

missing_declaration._note: A declaration that is not found is NEEDS_VERIFICATION. Measured on the synthetic validation set, treating OCR absence as proof produced a NON_COMPLIANT finding on 31% of defect-free, fully photographed labels (OCR misses, mostly blurred / stamped text), versus 1.5% when absence stays 'needs verification'. Absence is therefore never concluded from OCR alone unless an administrator sets allow_non_compliant_from_ocr_absence=true; then it is concluded only when the inspector confirms all panels were photographed, no image is POOR and mean OCR confidence >= min_mean_ocr_confidence.
